Parks On The Air，公园通联: Parks On The Air — operating from parks
Summits On The Air，山峰通联: Summits On The Air — operating from summits
World Wide Flora & Fauna，全球动植物保护区: World Wide Flora & Fauna — protected areas worldwide
在保护区设台，国际版 POTA。: Set up in a protected area — the international version of POTA.
在指定公园内设台，与 SOTA 类似但更易参与。: Set up inside a listed park; similar to SOTA but easier to take part in.
在指定山峰登顶设台，激活者与追逐者均可积分。: Set up on a listed summit; both activators and chasers score points.
常用频段：20m/40m SSB 或 CW，配合 FT8/FT4 快速积累通联。: Usual bands: 20 m/40 m SSB or CW, plus FT8/FT4 to accumulate contacts quickly.
户外注意安全：防雷、防雨、携带充足电源与饮水。: Take care outdoors: lightning, rain, and carry enough power and water.
提前发布激活计划（SOTAwatch 等），让追逐者守候。: Announce your activation in advance (on SOTAwatch and similar) so chasers can listen for you.
装备轻量化：便携电台 + 便携天线 + 电池（磷酸铁锂）。: Travel light: a portable radio plus a portable antenna and battery (LiFePO4).
